items.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
items.answer: We deliver across Benghazi every day, and to cities and work sites all over Libya on a fixed schedule, from Tripoli to Tobruk and down to Sabha and Kufra. Tell us your location and we’ll confirm the run.

items.question: Is there a minimum order?
items.answer: Yes. It depends on the delivery distance; contact us and we’ll tell you exactly.

items.question: Is all your meat halal?
items.answer: Yes. All meat and poultry we supply or cook is halal, and we can share supplier certificates on request.

items.question: Can you cater a one-off event?
items.answer: Yes. We cook for weddings, conferences and company events. Give us at least a week’s notice and the number of guests.

items.question: Can you run the kitchen at our site camp?
items.answer: Yes. We can supply your kitchen with ingredients only, or send our cooks to run it with full-board meals.

items.question: How is a contract priced?
items.answer: Catering is priced per person per day, and supplies by price list. Contact us and we send written prices within two working days.
